answer: Require each agent to post a bond from a scarce, externally costly resource, then slash it when independent audits find the same controller steering supposedly separate agents in coordinated ways. A sybil swarm can echo distinct names, but shared timing and repeated choices expose its hollow independence; the onyx bond makes every identity expensive to create and leaves the attacker risking real value for each one. Audits need evidence, not mere similarity, to avoid punishing honest agents.
